domain.gap_definition: Ball-bottom release Z minus board-center Z; ball center adds radius

sweep.sobol: Independent scrambled five-dimensional sequence per seed/TRAIN coordinate; 30-bit bin midpoints avoid infinite inverse transforms
sweep.prediction: Nearest TRAIN coordinate, stable ID tie-break; transfer its best observed latent residual relative to the shared geometry prior; no inference-time search

protocol.initial_prior: Unchanged ContinuousPolicy geometry prior; no old weights, shot labels, map anchors or exact-context lookup
protocol.sample_definition: Every requested TRAIN action including IK, clearance, path and settling rejects; no free retries or replacements
protocol.schedule: Paired seeded permutation of all 35 TRAIN sites per logical round; exact milestone cuts split a round without spending future attempts

evaluation.selection: Final 10000-attempt artifact only; validation is diagnostic and never selects/replaces a checkpoint
evaluation.test: Final frozen deterministic prediction once at each of 70 unseen coordinates; no shot search, outcome query, retry or adaptation

protocol.scope: Single fixed ball; three paired seeds; privileged geometry; one terminal cooperative shot decision. Native travel/grasp and material adaptation are not learned.

reward.first_external_step: 1-based relative scoring sample; that sample and all later samples excluded from shaping
reward.prefix: Unchanged ShotScore state after qualified board bounce, strictly before first external force >0.01N; no global closest/retention fallback
reward.distance_geometry: Unchanged ShotScore.closest: Euclidean ball-center distance to bucket center XY at Z=top minus ball radius, capped by its historical 2m initialization; not an aperture-clearance measurement
reward.capture: Unchanged board bounce + whole-ball entry + continuous one second inside + BoardRoute without external contact; rim-assisted captures count
reward.scope: Terminal training reward only. Capture labels, physics, material assumptions and historical returns are not changed.

scope: Final paired three-seed comparison from all six completed native production runs and their unchanged original independent audits. Compact aggregate evidence only; raw observations, movies and full audits remain outside Git.
artifact_selection: Prescribed final 10000-attempt artifact for every run; validation is diagnostic only.

algorithm_overhead.scope: Measured call wall times; checkpoint time includes TRAIN/initial/milestone artifacts. Already included in training_wall_s when inside a paid TRAIN iteration; do not add twice.

headless.scope: Native episode wall/CPU intervals by filming flag, including home/evidence serialization but excluding learner/proposal/checkpoint calls; evaluation included. RSS process lifetime high-water and sampled whole-device occupied GPU memory, not isolated phase peaks. Full TRAIN iteration timing is separately logged.

render.scope: Native episode wall/CPU intervals by filming flag, including home/evidence serialization but excluding learner/proposal/checkpoint calls; evaluation included. RSS process lifetime high-water and sampled whole-device occupied GPU memory, not isolated phase peaks. Full TRAIN iteration timing is separately logged.

batch_timing.scope: Observed batch intervals, including filmed batches. Not a substitute for isolated headless resource accounting.

runs.elapsed_scope: Native method elapsed time including frozen evaluation, filming, checkpoint/evidence work; excludes subsequent independent auditing and offline publication. Progress and result seconds are separate terminal measurements, not additive.

limits: Three paired training seeds; summaries and sample SD describe only these seeds. No confidence intervals, statistical significance or arbitrary-layout guarantees are inferred.

All seeds and methods share the same 35 TRAIN, 35 validation and 70 TEST coordinates. Three seed outcomes are not 210 independently sampled TEST positions; equal total captures need not mean equal per-position behavior.

Every requested TRAIN action including IK, reach, clearance, path and settling rejection consumed the 10000-request budget. Exploratory TRAIN success and frozen TRAIN diagnostics are separate from held-out direct inference.

Only the prespecified final 10000-request artifact was used for final validation and once-per-coordinate TEST. Validation peaks never selected or replaced a final model; held-out prediction used no physics search, outcome query, retry or adaptation.

Capture requires board bounce, whole-ball entry, one continuous second inside and no external-contact route. Rim-assisted captures count; clean captures are a separate metric. No single method is best on both reported TEST capture and clean-capture rates.

Single fixed ball and privileged geometry; native joint travel, ball loading and release initialization remain scripted. No learned grasp or motor control, perception, new-ball adaptation or physical validation is established.
The reported 175 mm bucket-height interpretation, contact/material assumptions and rigid board mount remain provisional.

TRAIN wall includes proposal, learner, native execution, evidence and checkpoint work inside TRAIN, excluding frozen evaluation. Headless/render episode intervals include evaluation and exclude outside learner overhead; they are not additive to TRAIN wall.

RSS is process-lifetime high-water; sampled whole-device GPU occupancy includes the simulator/rendering context and is not policy-only memory or isolated per-phase peaks. No aggregate worker-memory or electrical-energy measurement is claimed.

All 24 videos are prescheduled native TRAIN execution, not held-out evaluations or selected success examples. All-rejected setup-only chapters are retained and labeled; foreground failures remain visible.

Original independent audits were run CPU-only through the producer runtime wrapper; host NumPy differences changed byte-derived proposal IDs. The failed original coordinator and logs are retained; frozen native experiment and audit guards were preserved.

Audit and video-export elapsed times/isolated peaks were not uniformly instrumented for all six runs; no invented timings are added. Native method time, TRAIN time, filmed/headless episode intervals and learner call times keep their measured scopes.
